# Toolique - Complete Catalog & Technical Reference for LLMs

## Overview
Toolique (https://www.toolique.in) is a free, privacy-focused online suite of interactive calculators, developer utilities, 3D printing tools, and programming academy modules. All computations run 100% locally in the user's browser using HTML5, Web APIs, and client-side JavaScript. No user input or calculations are transmitted to external servers.

## Categories & Tools

### Architecture & Statutory Bye-Laws (Flagship Indian Feasibility Engine)
- Building Feasibility & Bye-Law Checker: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/building-feasibility-checker
  - Description: Location-aware preliminary architectural feasibility assessment tool evaluating 172+ verified Indian statutory bye-law documents.
  - Multi-Tier Legal Hierarchy: NBC 2016 (National), 36 States/UTs Unified Building Codes, 50 City Master Plans, and 66 Local Municipal Authorities & Statutory Overlays.
  - Development Controls: Permissible FAR/FSI, Base vs Purchasable FAR, Ground Coverage (%), Maximum Height (m/ft), Stilt + 4 Floors rules, Mandatory Setbacks (Front, Rear, Left, Right), Parking ECS, and High-Rise Fire NOC clearance threshold.
  - Visual Envelope: 2D plot & buildable footprint SVG diagram with dual-unit dimension conversions (m/ft and sq.m/sq.ft).
- FAR & FSI Calculator: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/far-fsi-calculator
- Plot Area & Irregular Land Calculator: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/plot-area-calculator
- Setback Calculator: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/setback-calculator
- Building Height & Clearance Calculator: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/building-height-calculator
- Plot Coverage Calculator: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/plot-coverage-calculator
- Carpet Area & RERA Calculator: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/carpet-area-calculator
- Staircase Dimension Calculator: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/staircase-calculator
- Room Area Calculator: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/room-area-calculator
- Space Planning Calculator: https://www.toolique.in/architecture/space-planning-calculator
